extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners and individuals petitioning for reinstatement before the USPTO (Office of Enrollment and Discipline)
extracted.subtask_description: A formal notice documenting the grant of a Petition for Reinstatement to practice before the USPTO under 37 CFR § 11.58, summarizing the filings reviewed and the Director's determination and effective date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of David N. Oskin received on 26 December 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A Petition for Reinstatement must be filed and will be docketed/dated; the petition itself is a primary document considered in the reinstatement decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Oskin filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit submitted under 37 CFR § 11.58 is a required supporting document for a reinstatement petition (per this notice); it supplies factual assertions relevant to eligibility for reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of review: petition, supporting affidavit, and record material
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... determined ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director considers the petition, the supporting affidavit, and all record material that is material to eligibility. Decisions are based on a comprehensive review of those materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's discretionary determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline determined that reinstatement of Mr. Oskin to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate and granted the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is a discretionary determination by the Director (or delegated official) made after review of filings and record information; the standard applied is whether reinstatement is 'appropriate' in the Director's judgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date of reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Accordingly, effective March 24, 2020, David N. Oskin is reinstated to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the petition is granted, the notice will state an effective date for reinstatement which marks when practice privileges before the USPTO are restored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority and signature for the notice
rubrics_metrics.description: William R. Covey Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement notices are issued and authenticated by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline (Deputy General Counsel/Director) and include the date of the notice.
